title: Database crash during checkpoint
reason: All three aspects match: the faulty component is the PostgreSQL DB, the issue is a crash/PANIC, and both point to underlying storage corruption as the trigger.
option_titles: Restart db container and disable rotate-logs job
root_cause: The PostgreSQL container crashed and stopped because the filesystem hosting its data directory (/var/lib/postgresql) suffered corruption or went read-only, evidenced by the PANIC log 'could not read block 12345 in file "base/1262/5.1": read-only filesystem or corrupted data' and the inability to access /var/lib/postgresql/data/base.
truth: A data page checksum failure during a checkpoint triggered a PostgreSQL PANIC. Automatic recovery attempted but failed because the corrupted page is in a critical system catalog, leaving the database process exited and unable to start.
check_first: Inspect the db container status with docker ps or docker container ls
